tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgo nas phung sri mnan pa'i man ngag ri rab phur bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badzra kī la ya/ dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgo nas phung sri mnan pa'i man ngag ni/ dug shog gi gzhi la phung sri'i gzugs mi lus bya mgo can/ rkang lag lcags sgrog gis bcings pa bya/ de'i snying khar gnas srog gi ngo bo tri yig dzaḥ kha sbyar gyi bar du gtim pa bris/ yan lag la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes bris/ dpung pa g.yas kyi thad nas mgo brtsams ste yi ge zhabs tu/ oṃ sarba na tri ni hūm̐ dzaḥ rinra tri ni hūm̐ dzaḥ su tri ni hūm̐ dzaḥ shant+ri hūm̐ dzaḥ ka tri ni hūm̐ dzaḥ kum̐ kum̐ dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ dam sri pho mo thams cad kyi snying la mā ra ya dzaḥrbad nan/ zhes snying kha'i srog gi yi ge la bskor te bris/ gzugs kyi mtha' mar dzaḥkhram gyis bskor ro/ /de nas rgyal po phung ba'i phung sri ni/ mon rabs kyi thod pa'am/ bod rigs ngan gyi thod par chos 'khor chen po'i dbus sam/ lha khang chen po'i them 'og mnan/ blon po phung ba'i phung sri ni/ spre'u dang ne tso dang / ri bong gi thod par 'dun pa gcig tu byed pa'i sar mnan/ yul mi phung ba'i phung sri ni/ mdzo rtol dang spre'u'i thod par lam gyi srang mdo'am/ yul gyi dbus su mnan/ dgra sri ni g.yag dang rta'i thod par dgra byung dogs sa'i gong gsum mam/ lam rgya gram dang / lung gsum mdor mnan/ dmangs sri ni g.yi dang 'phar spyang gi thod par grong khyer chen po'i dbus su mnan/ pha bu dang ma bu'i byur yugs kyi sri ni/ khyi phag rnga mong gi thod par them pa'i 'og tu mnan/ chung sri ni khyi phrug dang phag byi la sre mong gi thod par mal gyi 'og tu mnan/ dur sri ni wa grum dang g.yi dang byi ba'i thod par dur zhabs mnan/ rnal 'byor pa'i dam sri ni/ mi khyi ra phag gi thod par mchod rten chen po'i 'og tu mnan/ god sri ni spre'u dang lug dang be'u'i thod par rwa ba'i dbus su mnan/

g.yal mo'i god sri ni/ 'phar ba dang rnga mong dang gwa pa'i thod par phong rwa'i dbus su mnan/ srang po'i g.yal sri ni/ 'phar ba'i thod par nyi 'od mi phog pa'i sar mnan/ zhes gsungs pas de'i tshul ni/ rnal 'byor pa rdo rje phur pa'i dbang thob cing bsnyen pa las su rung ba ting nge 'dzin brtan po dang ldan pas sems can la phan gdags pa'i phyir phung sri gnon pa'i tshul ni/ bla ma gong mas byin gyis brlabs shing 'dre srin gdug pa can gnas pa'i sa ma yin par gnam sa bar gsum gyi drag po'i rgyan ci 'byor dang / rtsa gsum bris 'bur gyi sku gang 'byor/ khyad par sgrub khang gi lho phyogs su rdo rje gzhon nu'i bris 'bur gyi sku gang rung bzhugs pa'i drung sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring ltar na dpal gtor lnga'am/ bsdus pa ltar na dpal gtor gcig sman raka yi dam chos skyong gzhan gyi gtor ma dgos na dang / chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod bcas bshams drung / sri gnon gyi 'brub khung la rgyas bsdus sna tshogs gsungs kyang / 'dir lag len bde ba'i phyir dur rdo gsum sgrom gyi steng lcags slang gas dang bug rdol med cing gzhan gyis longs ma spyod pa'i kha la 'jim pa'am zan skyor byas la/ se ba 'om bu skyer pa gsum gyi rtsang ku ru kha ji ltar rigs pa khrag gis byugs pa btsugs nang gong gi lidga la 'byung bzhi'i sbyang ba snying lugs ltar ram gsar ma ltar na ling gzugs me long la shar ba la bum chu'i khrus dang / sa 'di dug gi sogs kyi tshigs bcad dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sogs kyis khrus byas nas bcug la re bas phur te rdo rje lta bus mnan/ de dang chabs cig 'og tu dgos pa'i 'jug snod thod pa dag par bkrus la spyi gtsug nas dpral ba'i bar oṃ sarba na tri sogs gong du bshad pa'i sngags yig phreng ltar bris/ dpral bar rgan sri dang gzhon sri nan zhes/

'gram g.yas la pho sri nan/ g.yon la mo sri nan rnams bris/ skud pa sngo dmar gyis rgya gram du bcings te 'brub khung du bcug liṅga'i mgo dang spus mo g.yas g.yon gyi thad du ra khyi phag gsum gyi gzugs 'jim sogs la bzos pa bzhag 'brub khung gi mdun du rdzas phor nang sri zan tsam pa sbang ma go thal gsum bsres nas brdzis pa'i chang bu/ sri sha ra sha lag pa sri chang ba ra rta gsum gyi 'o mar sbyar ba'i go thal gyi skyo ma sri yos tshig nag la song ba rnams thun gang byed la gos chas dang bcas pa dang / 'brub khung gi g.yas g.yon la snod so sor gu gul/ yungs dkar/ sngo dmar gyi zhags pa/ dug khrag lcags zangs/ rdo phye rnams dang / dgug gzhug gi tshe bsreg rgyu'i ra sha ra tshil mi rkang rta rkang rnams dang / mnan pa'i tshe dgos pa'i gad pa chad pa'i sa nag tsha/ ba tsha/ bul tog ro g.yam la rdo rje rgya gram bris pa/ sbra tshal/ tshon skud sna lnga/ sman sna/ dar sna/ rin chen lnga/ mchod rten rnying pa'i rmang gi sa/ ra spu phyin ci log tu bsgril ba rnams dang / rang gi mdun du rdor dril/ nang mchod/ ḍā ma ru/ 'thor nas/ bsnyen phur lnga'am gcig yungs dkar/ gzhan yang rnga rol rkang gling sogs 'dus byas la/ rdo rje phur pa'i mngon rtogs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang rung gis rnga bying bab nas bzung tshogs bar pa yan phyag len bzhin grub pa dang / rig 'dzin bskul dang phur kha bsgyur ba/ de nas ling khebs bsal/ ra khyi phag gsum dang / thod pa ma bsdus par bzhag la/ dgug gzhug gsum/ tshe srog ye shes su bsgyur ba/ lha srung spyan drangs pa/ gsal ba gsum dang gdan gsum gyi sgo nas nga rgyal bskyed pa/ rgyud gsum ma'i dpang gzug rnams byas la rnga rol bzhag bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni rang gi snying kha nas rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs phur srung dang bcas pa lcags kyu zhags pa mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa rnams kyis sri ngan gdug pa can la yang 'brel so drug gi las mdzad par bsam la/

thog mar kī la ya ji ltar rigs pa dang / sngags kyi dngos gzhi/ hūm̐ sa ra bidyā tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭa zhes pa nas/ bhindha ya bhindha ya hūm̐ phaṭa zhes pa'i bar sbrel la brgya stong ngam tha ma'ang 'phreng 'khor gcig tsam bzla/ yang oṃ sarba na tri ni zhes sogs liṅga dang thod par bris pa'i sngags de yang brgya stong sogs bzla ba ni shin tu gal che bar bshad do/ /de nas gu gul sogs yang 'brel so drug gi rdzas de dag la mchil ma ma shor bar phus gdab/ lha dang phral ba nas bzung zhal du btab pa'i bar phur bzlog bzhin byas la/ zhag sbrel nas sgrub na ling khebs dang rdo rje bzhag thun gtor 'bul ba sogs gzhug chog rnams bya/ mnan pa'i nyin zhal du btab tshar ba'i rjes su/ lag pa bkrus kha ras dang bcas pas liṅga 'brub khung nas phyung la mgo nas phyir lus ma rdzogs kyi bar nar mor bsgril la g.yas lteb g.yon lteb gong gi tshon skud sna lnga'i mdun nas rgyab tu dkris/ g.yon nas g.yas su dkris/ mgo mjug sogs kyi rnam dbye med par thod pa'i klad khung nas bcug de'i rjes su gong gi ba ra rta'i 'o ma'i thal skyo blug sman dar rin chen sna lnga sgrub pa'i tshe 'brub khung du 'phangs tshe 'brub khung du 'phangs pa'i thun rnams dang / mchod rten rnying pa'i rmang gi sa rnams kyis thod pa khengs par bkang / klad khung la chas rgya gram gyis bkag thod pa de re bas dril/ ra spu'i thag pas mdun nas rgyab dang / g.yon nas g.yas su dkris pa'i mdud pa dpral ba lta bur yong ba byas la la cha'i steng tshwa ba tshwa bul tog gsum bsres pa'i khro zhal lam rdo rje rgya gram gyi thel btab ra spu'i thag pas bsnol mar bcings pa de la rtsang rnams rtse yar bstan la ku ru khar bzung sla ngar bcug re bas kha bcad la gtor ma gru gsum sha khrag gis brgyan pa dang / gser skyems kyi chas gang gi ro g.yam/ mi bsad gri/ rnga ma nag po'i rlung g.yab/

me sbar ba'i shing phran bu/ ga ru lta bur chu/ ting phor lta bur sa ser/ me long rnams khyer la rang nyid zhwa gos nag po rus rgyan ban phur sogs kyi chas su 'jug pa'am/ ma zhugs kyang rung / rnga rol rkang gling g.yab dar nag po gu gul dang bcas pas gang du mnan pa'i sa der/ thog ma nas dong gru gsum brko ba ni btsod kyi rwa la klu sman byugs pas dang por brus/ de nas tog rtse sogs kyis brus la rting ring thung sor nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi tshad du byas pa de'i khar song la/ gtor ling mnan rdzas rnams mdun du bzhag oṃ badzra kro dha zhes sogs gser skyems byin rlabs byas la/ rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa dang / zhes sogs sam/ bla ma rig 'dzin tshogs bcas mchod/ /zhes sogs gser skyems rgyas bsdus gang rung btang ba'i mthar/ mi bsad kyi gri thogs la/ rkang gling g.yab dar/ rol mo dgu brdung dang / mnan dong du gshin rje 'bod pa ni/ hūm̐ gdug pa 'dul mdzad rdo rje gzhon nu ni/ /gnag pa'i ma drug mnan pa'i las mdzad phyir/ /gnam lcags 'bar ba'i ral gri phyag na bsnams/ /drag shul rgyun las sa gzhi gas pa'i nang / /mig sman ltar gnag 'og gzhi'i rgya mtsho che/ /mi bzad rlabs drag 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil nas/ /las kyi gshin rje nag po ma rungs pa/ /'chi bdag chos kyi rgyal po mngon sum gyur/ /oṃ kriṣṇa dzaḥm ti hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes dang / rnga rol rkang gling g.yab dar gu gul gyi dud pa bcas byas la dong kha der gri 'debs pa'i stangs ka lan gsum byed/ dgu brdung chems brdung rkang gling g.yab dar dgu brdung byas la rnga rol bzhag gong gi gtor ma de 'bru gsum lan gsum gyis dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag tu dmigs/ rdor thal kha phye'i mthar se gol gtog pa dang bcas/ oṃ kriṣṇa dza ma ti ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hī/ zhes gsum bdun sogs kyis bsngos la 'chi bdag gshin rje nag po khyod kyis phung sri gdug pa can 'di byang chub kyi sems ma skyes kyi bar du ma btang zhig ces brjod/

de nas lag lcibs dang bcas pas mnan thod bzung la rnga brdung zhing / hūm̐ ri rab chen po'i rmong 'og mun pa'i gnas/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i ting rung rlung gseb nas/ /lcags kyi khang pa nag po sgo med nas/ /las kyi gshin rje lus chen yan lag rags/ /gdangs pa'i kha nas gshin rje'i rlangs pa thul/ /ma he nag po'i rtar zhon dbyug tho dang / /thams cad 'ching ba'i zhags pa nag po thogs/ /gshin yul gshin rje'i 'jig rten rme nag zhes/ /zin nas thar med sdug bsngal mun gling nas/ /'chi bdag gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po la/ /mngon shes mthu dang rdzu 'phrul nus par ldan/ /dge sdig ma 'dres bye ba'i zhal lce mkhan/ /gtum chen khyod la phung sri 'di nyid gtad/ /'chi bdag gshin rje nag po dam tshig can/ /gtad pa'i bgegs 'di slar yang ma btang cig /ces brjod nas dgu brdung chem brdung rkang gling g.yab dar thod pa dong nang du skyur/ oṃ kriṣṇa dza ma ri hūm̐/ dgra bgegs 'di'i ma hā maṃ sa khā hi/ rakta khā hi/ tsitta khā hi/ go ro tsa na khā hi/ zhes pas zhal du btab/ dho dhi a yaṃḥ zhes brjod pas gshin rje nag po rang gnas su song bar bsam/ chems brdung rdzogs nas/ dgu brdung mthar gsum brdeg len can rnga rol bzhag g.yam pa la rdo rje rgya gram bris pa des mnan la/ dong sa skam rlon gyis shin tu khengs par bkang zhing 'thas par bcags la/ hūm̐ dang po ting 'dzin rtse gcig rgyaḥ gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgyaḥ gsum pa sku gsung thugs rgyaḥ bzhi pa tshad med bzhi yi rgyaḥ lnga pa ye shes lnga yi rgyaḥ drug pa pha rol phyin drug rgyaḥ bdun pa yan lag bdun gyi rgyaḥ brgyad pa rnam mthar brgyad kyi rgyaḥ dgu pa theg pa rim dgu'i rgyaḥbacu pa sa bcu'i dbang phyug rgyaḥ don dang brda sbyar rtags kyi tshulaḥ gnyis su med pa'i rgyas gdab boḥ oṃ laṃ āḥlaṃ hūm̐ laṃ stambha ya nanaḥ bro brdung bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugasaḥ

yon tan phrin las yongs rdzogs pa: dpal chen khro rgyal 'khor bcas kyis: 'jig rten khams kun rab bkang nas: nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi ba dang : tshe dang longs spyod rgyas par mdzod: khams gsum srid gsum dbang du bsdus: gnod byed dgra bgegs brlag par mdzod: shintaṃ/ puṣṭiṃ/ ba shaṃ/ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ rlung g.yab kyis g.yab te/ yaṃ stambha ye nan nan me sbar te/ raṃ stambha ye nan nan/ chu bran te/ baṃ stambha ye nan nan/ sa ser gtor la/ laṃ stambha ye nan nan/ me long bstan la/ khaṃ stambha ye nan nan/ zhes brjod la de steng tho brtsegs rnga rol dang bcas/ nam mkha' rlung me chu sa'i dkyil 'khor steng / /laṃ las gser gyi ri rab bang rim can/ /de steng rin chen las grub pho brang du/ /sangs rgyas don yod grub pa 'khor dang bcas/ /bskal pa ma stongs bar du tiṣṭha lhan/ /ces brjod mnan pa'i steng du sangs rgyas don yod grub pas pho brang btab par bsam zhing / stong nyid kyi lta bas rgyas thebs par bya'o/ /de nas dril gsil me tog dang bcas pas/ skye med chos sku'i sogs bkra shis brjod la rol mo'i sgra bya/ nang du log nas tshogs la longs spyad lhag ma bstan skyong mjug chog rnams bya'o/ /zhes dpal ldan rdo rje gzhon nus chos skor las byang gter byang phur pa drag sngags kyi chos skor nas byung ba'i phung sri mnan pa'i man ngag la 'don cha dang lag len mi 'gal ba rnams chos rje bla ma dang / sngags 'chang rgya gar pa/ sa lo chen po/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po rnams kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang / phur bzlog bzhin sbyar/ dmigs bsal rnams ma 'dres par bkod pa'i yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyi bsdebs pa'o// //maṅga lam// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 kun dga' blo gros/ dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgo nas phung sri mnan pa'i man ngag PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
